name: Lens.org
tagline: Lens.org is a free open-access platform covering 330 million patents and 240 million scholarly works with AI-powered search and analytics. Researchers and IP professionals use it to explore the intersection of academic research and patent activity, identify prior art, and analyse innovation landscapes.
